description: Rothco’s Reversible Airport Friendly Riggers Belt offers the perfect combination of durability, versatility, and ease for everyday and tactical use. Designed with a different color on each side, this reversible belt provides you with multiple styling options in a single belt. The fully adjustable belt features double-layered nylon with 6 rows of stitching, providing superior strength and durability to support your gear. The belt’s plastic matte-finished buckle is airport-friendly, allowing for quick and easy access through metal detectors without the hassle of removing it. Measuring 1.5 inches wide, this belt offers a secure fit and comes in various sizes to accommodate different waist sizes. Whether you're dressing for work, travel, or outdoor activities, Rothco's reversible belt is a dependable, functional, and stylish accessory that you can rely on.
